subject: Cloudworks: final DPA, SOC2 link and PO routing

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@cloudworks.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, ProcureOps <procureops@cloudworks.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding — DPA, SOC2 link and PO details

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. Per our onboarding checklist I’m attaching the latest DPA (Cloudworks_DPA_v2.1.pdf) and the current subprocessor register (Cloudworks_Subprocessors_2026-11.csv). I’ve also uploaded our SOC 2 Type II report — link below — for your security team to review.

Can you confirm the PO creation steps on your side and where we should send the final invoice? Specifically we need:
- Legal company name for the PO
- Billing address and remittance email
- Any supplier form or W‑9 equivalent you require
- Preferred payment terms (Net30 is our default, but happy to align)

We’ll prepare the DocuSign envelope for the DPA after you confirm the contact who will e‑sign. I included ProcureOps in case they need to route a PO.

SOC2 report (uploaded): https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudworks/soc2-report-2026.pdf
Attachments: Cloudworks_DPA_v2.1.pdf, Cloudworks_Subprocessors_2026-11.csv

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Finance, Cloudworks
alyssa.chen@cloudworks.com
+1 415‑555‑0198

Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — DPA, SOC2 link and PO details

Alyssa — thanks for sending these over and for the SOC2 link. Quick notes and next steps from our side: 

1) PO details we need from you (please confirm in reply):
   - Legal name for PO: (exact legal entity)
   - Billing / remittance address
   - Invoice remittance email (for AP)
   - Company Tax ID / VAT (if applicable)
   - Bank details only after PO is issued (we do not accept bank details in email)

2) DPA / eSign: Redwood prefers DocuSign for contract execution. If the attached DPA is your standard, we’ll have Legal review then send a DocuSign envelope to the primary signer. Please confirm the name/email of your signatory.

3) SOC2: Security will validate the report; assuming ok we’ll mark the security gate satisfied. If security needs additional artifacts (system diagram, penetration test summary), I’ll loop them in.

4) Point people: I’m coordinating the security review. Karthik (copied) will lead the vendor security acceptance. Laura (cc) will own PO issuance and invoice path.

If you can reply with the PO legal name and the preferred signer for eSign today, Laura will start the PO flow and we’ll route the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Vendor Onboarding Lead — Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — DPA, SOC2 link and PO details

Alyssa / Mina — closing the loop from procurement.

1) PO issued: PO# RW‑2026‑5817 (amount: TBD — invoice to reference the PO). Please send invoice PDF to ap@redwoodinference.com and include PO# RW‑2026‑5817 in the subject and on the invoice body.

2) DPA flow: Legal reviewed the DPA and requested one small redline (Appendix A: change data retention from 3 years to 2 years for pilot customers). If Cloudworks is OK with that redline, send the DocuSign envelope to legal@redwoodinference.com and jerome.park@cloudworks.com and cc: procurement <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>. We’ll coordinate final sign.

3) Subprocessors: Karthik has started the acceptance review. He asked for a short mapping (service -> subprocessor -> location) for any entries marked as high risk; if you can add a one‑line mapping in the CSV for those rows, it will speed review.

Next steps for you (Alyssa):
- Confirm acceptance of the single redline (retention -> 2 years)
- Send DocuSign envelope to legal@redwoodinference.com, jerome.park@cloudworks.com, cc laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
- Send initial invoice after signing and reference PO RW‑2026‑5817

Once Jerome signs and Karthik clears the subprocessors, we’ll flip the switch in the vendor registry and enable production access.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
